name: Hammer Giant
flavour: Slow to arrive. Sudden when it does.
art_prompt: a hulking desert ogre giant with grey-brown weathered skin, a huge bald head with a heavy brow, small eyes and a wide underbite with two tusks, a ragged hide loincloth and a thick rope belt, tree-trunk legs and bare feet, holding an enormous stone sledgehammer with a thick wooden handle in both hands with its head resting on one shoulder, two arms and two legs, standing on the ground facing the viewer, the sledgehammer has exactly one long straight wooden handle gripped in both fists
motion: lumbering in place with slow heavy steps, the huge stone hammer resting on its shoulder the whole time
anim_negative: extra arms, a third arm, two hammers, extra legs, extra heads, a second handle, two handles, two hammers
dead_hint: lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: eyes shut tight, tongue hanging out, its body stretched out sideways across the picture with its head on the left and its feet on the right, the huge stone hammer lying on the ground beside its open hand
back_hint: It still holds the enormous stone hammer over one shoulder, the hammer's head visible above its shoulder. The hammer has one single straight wooden handle.
doc: The giant: slow, three metres of it, 280 HP. Close enough, it raises the hammer (a red ring) and smacks the floor for 42 and a throw across the sand. Never more than three; now and then a chest (8%) or a Berserk (12%) falls from one.

HG-0.note: Pass 45: grey-brown, the hammer on the shoulder (its handle showed across the back)

HG-A.note: Ochre-sand skin, the hammer hanging at his side
